learning_outcomes.text: Students learn what their rights are in working life and how to solve their problems alone without needing the help of a lawyer or someone else if these rights are violated.
Students learn the consequences of unlawful acts.
Students learn the types of employment contracts.

syllabus_topics: Place of labor law in the distinction of branches of law
Sources of labor law, basic principles and approaches guiding labor law
Basic concepts of labor law: employee, employer, employer representative, workplace, enterprise, apprentice
Concept and types of employment contract
Eligibility for employment contract, limits of eligibility for employment contract, obligations to enter into employment contract
Debts of employee and employer arising from the employment contract, concept of wage, base wage, additional wage, wage systems, wage guarantee, minimum wage, deduction for damages, wage cut penalty
Working hours, concept of overtime, break time, annual paid leave
Working hours, concept of overtime, break time, annual paid leave
Cases of termination of employment contract, consequences, severance pay
Cases of termination of employment contract, consequences, severance pay

Collective labor law: Concept of trade union: characteristics of trade unionism in Turkey, conditions for founding a trade union, mandatory organs of trade unions, rights and obligations arising from trade union membership, termination of trade unions, collective labor agreements, definition, characteristics of collective labor agreements in Turkey, procedure for concluding collective labor agreements
Peaceful dispute resolution methods in collective labor disputes: mediation and arbitration, strike: general definition, legal and illegal strike definitions
Elements of legal strike, lockout, general definition, concepts of legal lockout and illegal lockout, elements of legal lockout
institution: Düzce University — Elektrik-Elektronik Mühendisliği (Electrical-Electronics Engineering), Normal Öğretim
